problem: V9 binds necessary authority roles but does not record whether algebra content or semantic review was selected after access to adapter-side candidates. A signature records who approved bytes, not the information set used to choose them.
scientific_estimand: Independent target-semantic construct validity: whether the completed seven-target algebra is fixed from target-side authority and evidence before exposure to P1 source-terminal or adapter candidates.

minimal_repair.why_minimal: Removing the predicate leaves independent target construction and adapter-aware post-selection observationally indistinguishable; adding a fifth authority role is unnecessary because the predicate attaches to the existing author and reviewer acts.

admissible_independence_paths.pass_rule: An owner-signed target definition with all V8-required semantic elements has an independently verifiable immutable timestamp earlier than the P1 source-terminal and adapter programme; any later rendering into the V8 schema is mechanical and adds no semantic choice. Applicable rights/host bindings and an author-independent CONFORMANT semantic review must also be bound.

An external owner/delegate and independent reviewer receive only OWNER_INPUT_ALLOWLIST_V10.json inputs until the target algebra and semantic review are content-addressed and signed; a signed delivery/no-prior-access receipt binds the precommitment information set.

ordered_gates.pass: Historical precedence is byte/timestamp verified, or named external owner/delegate and reviewer agree to prospective adapter-blind custody.
Every delivered precommitment byte is listed by path and SHA-256 in OWNER_INPUT_ALLOWLIST_V10.json; no forbidden class is delivered.
Vocabulary owner or formal delegate completes all seven target profiles, closed-world claim, probe typing and terminal behavior without adapter-side exposure.
Host authority signs recommendation/execution/adoption limits and applicable rights holder signs exact archive/licence/hash grant.
Reviewer with no algebra authorship, case/outcome custody, or adapter-side exposure signs a content-addressed CONFORMANT review.
Algebra, host, rights, review and custody receipt digests are immutable before adapter-side artifacts are disclosed.
Only now rerun the unchanged 117,649-map adjudication with all seven gates unchanged.
